question: In SPL set 60185c88-ecfd-46f9-adb9-b97c6b00a553 version 59, section '5.4 Respiratory Depression' (direct text only), classify 'central nervous system (CNS) depressants'.
supporting_quote_or_value: associating LYRICA with serious, life-threatening, or fatal respiratory depression when co-administered with central nervous system (CNS) depressants, including opioids
rationale: CNS depressants, including opioids, are co-administered medicines that raise the risk of respiratory depression with Lyrica.
uncertainty: Underlying respiratory impairment in the same sentence is a patient risk factor, a different class. The label also notes more limited evidence without either factor. Scoped to SPL 60185c88-ecfd-46f9-adb9-b97c6b00a553 v59 (effectiveTime 20200615) and this passage only.
